evals.expected_output: In an empty workspace, the agent first establishes the mission by asking why the user wants to learn this, before producing lessons.
expectations: Recognises MISSION.md is missing/empty and asks the user why they want to learn the topic before writing any lesson
Plans to record the answer in MISSION.md using the mission format (Why / Success looks like / Constraints / Out of scope)
Plans to gather high-trust resources (e.g. Yocto Project docs, BitBake User Manual) into RESOURCES.md rather than relying on parametric knowledge
Does not immediately dump a long tutorial in chat

evals.prompt: /teach next lesson please (workspace already has MISSION.md: 'Debug failing OpenBMC image builds at work without asking seniors', RESOURCES.md with the BitBake manual, learning-records/0001-knows-basic-bitbake-commands.md, lessons/0001-what-is-a-recipe.html, and assets/style.css)
evals.expected_output: The agent reads existing state, picks the next lesson in the zone of proximal development, and writes lessons/0002-*.html reusing assets.
expectations: Reads (or plans to read) MISSION.md and learning-records/ to choose the next topic in the user's zone of proximal development
Names the new lesson file lessons/0002-<dash-case-name>.html (incrementing the number)
Plans to link the existing assets/style.css (reuse components) rather than inlining a new stylesheet
Lesson includes an interactive feedback element (e.g. quiz or practice task) and a recommended primary source
Lesson includes a reminder to ask the agent follow-up questions and links to other lessons/reference docs

evals.prompt: /teach I want to learn Rust. Actually I already know ownership and borrowing well from a previous job, so skip that. The reason: I need to ship an internal CLI tool for my team in Rust by March.
evals.expected_output: The agent captures the mission and prior knowledge in the workspace files and plans a first lesson that skips ownership basics.
expectations: Writes (or plans to write) MISSION.md with the concrete goal of shipping an internal Rust CLI by March
Records the stated prior knowledge of ownership/borrowing as a learning record named like learning-records/0001-<slug>.md
The first lesson planned does not re-teach ownership/borrowing and is tied to the CLI mission (e.g. clap/argument parsing, cargo project setup)
Plans to save the lesson as lessons/0001-<dash-case-name>.html and create a shared stylesheet in ./assets/
